nearMisses.signal: PR #61 used canonicalHash128 for absence evidence/content/proof integrity.
nearMisses.resolution: PR #65 retains compact identity hashing only for observationId and moves all integrity hashes to SHA-256.

nearMisses.signal: Initial crypto-aware absence observation retained evidenceHash but not the canonical evidence itself, preventing independent recomputation after restore.
nearMisses.resolution: Observation now stores canonical evidence and recomputes evidenceHash/contentHash on read/restore.

securityNote: SHA-256 proves integrity/corruption resistance for trusted store boundaries; it does not authenticate a malicious writer that can replace evidence and recompute hashes. Store authorization/audit remains a separate trust boundary.
nextSafeAction: Implement a driver-neutral append-only Postgres/Supabase AuthorityAbsenceObservationStore on this exact lineage, with insert-only idempotency, conflict detection and recomputation of evidence/content hashes before any real provider retry path.
